reason: A local knowledge workspace for importing sources, retrieving relevant content, chatting with citations, and generating structured study and reference materials.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识工作台，可导入文件、网页和文本，通过检索式对话管理并生成带来源的学习与研究材料。
summaries.en: A local knowledge workspace for DeepSeek Harness that imports files, web pages, and text, supports retrieval-based cited chat, and generates structured study and research materials.

capabilities: imports and stores local files, URLs, and pasted text
performs web retrieval and search through the host web service
uses an LLM to generate cited answers and study materials
delegates multimodal transcription to an attached MCP plugin
